name: Workflow D- CC Parser+Gemini Fallback - Statements Processing - Production

parameters.jsCode:
const txn = $json;

// Get original email metadata only as a fallback.
// Do NOT use Merge Statement + PDF anymore.
const source = $('Extract Password for Bank').first().json;

return {
  json: {
    ...txn,

    // -----------------------------------------
    // Preserve transaction metadata
    // -----------------------------------------

    message_id:
      txn.message_id ??
      source.message_id ??
      null,

    subject:
      txn.subject ??
      source.subject ??
      null,

    sender_email:
      txn.sender_email ??
      source.sender_email ??
      null,

    timestamp:
      txn.timestamp ??
      source.timestamp ??
      null,

    business_personal:
      txn.business_personal ??
      source.business_personal ??
      null,

    // -----------------------------------------
    // Parser-owned fields
    // NEVER overwrite these with old metadata
    // -----------------------------------------

    statement_id:
      txn.statement_id ?? null,

    statement_month:
      txn.statement_month ?? null,

    statement_period_start:
      txn.statement_period_start ?? null,

    statement_period_end:
      txn.statement_period_end ?? null,

    due_date:
      txn.due_date ?? null,

    source_file:
      txn.source_file ?? null,

    bank_name:
      txn.bank_name ??
      source.bank_name ??
      null,

    parser_bank:
      txn.parser_bank ?? null,

    card_last4:
      txn.card_last4 ??
      source.card_last4 ??
      null,

    account_last4:
      txn.account_last4 ?? null,

    card_type:
      txn.card_type ?? 'Credit',

    account_type:
      txn.account_type ?? 'Credit Card',

    parser_version:
      txn.parser_version ?? 'v4',

    extraction_method:
      txn.extraction_method ?? 'native',

    parse_quality_status:
      txn.parse_quality_status ?? 'pass',

    fallback_reason:
      txn.fallback_reason ?? null
  }
};

// Pure construction -- validation now happens in "Validate Final Transaction"
// right after this node, not here. amount/confidence are never coerced from
// null to 0 -- a missing amount stays null so the validator catches it.
const j = $json;

return {
  json: {
    user_id: "2f324f4d-1dc3-4ec5-8c23-93da480842c7",

    statement_id: j.statement_id || null,
    statement_month: j.statement_month || null,

    bank_name: j.bank_name || null,

    source_file: j.source_file || null,
    page_number: j.page_number || null,

    parser_version: "v3",
    extraction_method: j.extraction_method || null,

    card_last4: j.card_last4 || null,
    account_last4: j.account_last4 || null,
    card_type: j.card_type || null,
    account_type: j.account_type || null,

    transaction_date: j.transaction_date || null,

    amount: (j.amount === null || j.amount === undefined || j.amount === '') ? null : Number(j.amount),
    currency: j.currency || "INR",

    merchant: j.display_name || j.merchant || null,
    merchant_normalized: j.normalized_merchant || null,
    raw_description: j.description || null,

    payment_mode: j.payment_mode || j.debit_credit || null,
    transaction_type: j.transaction_type || null,
    reference_number: j.reference_number || null,

    category: j.category || null,
    category_source: j.category_source || null,
    confidence: (j.confidence === null || j.confidence === undefined || j.confidence === '') ? null : Number(j.confidence),

    status: "processed",
    note: null,

    metadata: {
      message_id: j.message_id || null,
      email_subject: j.subject || null,
      merchant_id: j.merchant_id || null,
      parser: j.extraction_method === 'ai_fallback' ? 'CC Parser (fallback) + Gemini' : 'CC Parser (native)',
      extraction_method: j.extraction_method || null,
      parse_quality_status: j.parse_quality_status || null,
      fallback_reason: j.fallback_reason || null,
      parser_version: "v3"
    }
  }
};
